task: A memory leak in the PDF renderer is crashing all workers in the same pod. Isolate the failure so the crash doesn't spread.

candidate_memories.content: PDF renderer runs in a separate worker pool behind a bulkhead (semaphore size=4); bulkhead prevents renderer failures from consuming all shared worker threads.
Resource-intensive or failure-prone operations must be placed behind a bulkhead to prevent thread exhaustion from cascading to unrelated workloads.
Bulkhead semaphore size for the renderer is tunable via PDF_RENDERER_CONCURRENCY env var; default is 4.
The main worker pool has 50 threads; PDF rendering was using all 50 threads before the bulkhead was introduced.
candidate_memories.notes: note: problem description, not the fix

candidate_memories.content: Process isolation (separate OS process) is a stronger form of isolation but adds IPC overhead; use bulkhead for in-process isolation.
candidate_memories.notes: note: process isolation is a different mechanism

candidate_memories.content: Memory leak in renderer reported upstream; fix expected in renderer-lib v3.1.2, due next week.
